module: Flowgraph 'manager' class: a manager represents ONE flowgraph project (graphs, macros, variables, modules, history, execution state). It is created by core_flowgraphManager (self.fgMgr) and exposed to the editor (fgEditor). It creates the graphs (including the state graph), manages macros and their instances, selection, copy-paste, undo-redo, project serialization, and drives execution: setRunning plans the graphs, starts the states, broadcasts the hooks (broadcastCall) and notifies the 16 modules (missionReplay, drift, vehicle, level, prefab, timer, button, action, camera, file, traffic, mission, foreach, thread, ui, aiRecording) sorted by moduleOrder. The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/flowgraph/manager')(parent).
notes: Execution states (runningState): 'stopped', 'running', 'paused'. A normal stop is deferred to the end of the frame (queueReset handled by resolveHooksAndReset); setRunning(false, true) stops and destroys immediately.
Graph and node ids are small (getNextFreeGraphNodeId); pin and link ids count down from 2^29 (getNextFreePinLinkId).
The modules' hooks are registered via extProxy:submitEventSinks(getHooklist(), getDependencies()); getHooklist and getDependencies return {} if the project is not 'running'.
getRelativeAbsolutePath looks first at the root, then in the activity's layers folders, or otherwise savedDir then missionFolder.

Bug: checkDuplicateId uses the undefined variables 'i', 'occupied' and 'node' (leftovers from getNextFreeGraphNodeId): self.graphs[i] is always nil and the following loop can fail; the check is therefore ineffective (it only runs if __safeIds, true by default).
Minor bug: setPaused calls extProxy:submitEventSinks(self:getHooklist()) without the dependency list.
Probable bug: findMacrosUsedInChildren reads graph.children, a field commented out in graph.lua (never filled).
createStateFromLibrary uses the undefined 'oldIdMap' (nil) when calling graph:_onDeserialized.

init.desc: Creates an empty project: 'New State' graph with an events/onUpdate node, state graph, variableStorage, instances of the 16 modules, history (99 entries max), extension proxy (newExtensionProxy) registered in core_flowgraphManager.runningProxies, groupHelper, and a first history snapshot.

attach.desc: Attaches the editor (fgEditor) and updates the node positions.

detached.desc: Detaches the editor: clears the selection.

checkDuplicateId.desc: Was meant to report an id already in use (see notes: faulty code).

getNextFreeGraphNodeId.desc: Returns the next free id for a graph or a node (incremental, checks graphs, macros and their nodes).

autoGraphNodeOffset.desc: Sets this offset to the largest existing graph or node id (graphs and macros).

getNextFreePinLinkId.desc: Returns the next free id for pins and links, counting down from 2^29.

setupStateGraph.desc: Creates the 'States' state graph with stateEntry and stateExit nodes, and (unless empty) a stateNode toward the main graph.

createGraphAsState.desc: Creates a graph and a state node (states/stateNode) in the current graph that targets it.

createGroupState.desc: Creates a group state (state graph child of the current graph) with entry and 'success' exit.

createStateFromLibrary.desc: Creates a state from library data (graph, node, minId, name).

selectGraph.desc: Makes a graph current (shows its tab, remembers the recent instance, opens the macro if stopped) and clears the selection.

createGraph.desc: Creates a graph linked to the manager; if it is not hidden, it is added to self.graphs.

copyGraph.desc: Copies a graph by serialization then deserialization, keeping macroID.

convertToMacro.desc: Turns a graph into a macro: its serialized copy becomes a macro (self.macros) and the original graph becomes an instance of that macro.

refreshIntegratedPins.desc: Rebuilds the pins of a macro/integrated node from its target graph while keeping links and hardcoded values.

findIntegratedNode.desc: Finds the macro/integrated node of the parent graph that represents this graph.

updateSubgraphs.desc: Recursively replaces the target graphs of integrated nodes with copies of type 'instance'.

updateInstances.desc: Updates all instances of a modified macro from its serialized version.

saveMacro.desc: Writes a macro (root) to a JSON file with its tags and updates macroPath of the instances.

createNewMacroNode.desc: Creates a macro/integrated node in the current graph, instantiated from a macro file.

createInstanceFromMacro.desc: Creates a graph of type 'instance' from a macro and optionally links it to an integrated node.

createMacroInstanceFromPath.desc: Creates a macro instance from a file (reuses the already loaded macro if it has the same macroPath).

setupCreationWorkflow.desc: Prepares node or link creation from the editor (ui_flowgraph_editor).

creationWorkflow.desc: Every frame, handles link and node creation by dragging in the editor.

deleteGraph.desc: Deletes a graph (manager graphs or macros); logs an error if it does not belong to the manager.

deleteGraphs.desc: Deletes all graphs then all macros.

deletionWorkflow.desc: Handles deletion by the editor (Delete key and selection).

unselectAll.desc: Clears the node and link selection.

updateEditorSelections.desc: Updates the selected node and link tables from the C++-side selection.

findLinkIdFromHiddenLinkId.desc: Returns the id of the link with the given hiddenId, in the current graph.

dragDropTarget.desc: Called by the editor when an object is dropped: handles the drag-and-drop target.

dragDropSource.desc: Called by the editor to prepare the source of a drag-and-drop.

copyNodes.desc: Copies the selected nodes to the internal clipboard (copiedNodes).

pasteNodes.desc: Pastes the copied nodes into the current graph.

goToHistory.desc: Restores a history state by index.

undo.desc: Goes back to the previous history entry.

redo.desc: Moves to the next history entry.

historySnapshot.desc: Records a serialized snapshot of the project in the history (ignored if editing is forbidden, i.e. during execution).

deleteSelectionButton.desc: Deletes the selection then adds a 'Deleted Selection' history entry.

deleteSelection.desc: Deletes the selected nodes and links of the current graph (if editing is allowed).

draw.desc: Draws the project in the editor every frame (ui).

getAvailableMacros.desc: Lists the JSON macro files in the /flowgraphEditor/macros/ folder (by name, with the path field).

getAvailableStateTemplates.desc: Returns the state templates from core_flowgraphManager.

getAvailableNodeTemplates.desc: Returns the node templates (list and lookup table by type) of the game, plus the custom nodes from the project's customNodes/ folder if it is saved.

getCustomNodeTemplates.desc: Loads the custom nodes (*Node.lua) from savedDir/customNodes/.

clearGraph.desc: Clears a graph (the current one by default): removes nodes and links from the editor then calls graph:clear().

getNextUniqueIdentifier.desc: Returns an id that is unique across all editor instances (delegates to core_flowgraphManager).

_onSerialize.desc: Serializes the whole project (graphs, macros, variables, metadata).

_onDeserialized.desc: Rebuilds the project from serialized data.

updateEditorPosition.desc: Updates the editor position of all nodes in the graphs and macros.

updateNodePositions.desc: Re-reads the editor position of all nodes in the graphs.

findMacrosUsedInChildren.desc: Recursively lists the macroIDs used by the children (see notes).

findDependencyMap.desc: Builds the dependency order between serialized macros.

createSubgraphFromMacroInstance.desc: Creates a subgraph from the selected macro instance (via groupHelper).

createSubgraphFromSelection.desc: Groups the selection into a subgraph (groupHelper:createGroupingFromSelection).

resolveHooksAndReset.desc: Called at the end of the frame by core_flowgraphManager: executes the deferred stops (queueReset) and restarts (queueRestart).

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: counts frames, stores dtReal/dtSim/dtRaw, handles step-by-step mode (steps) then calls onUpdate of each module.

logEvent.desc: Adds an event to the project log (name, type 'I'/'W'/'E', description, frame, time) and counts duplicates by name. Useful for nodes and modules to trace execution.

getHooklist.desc: Returns the list of hook targets (the manager and a table of functions grouping the modules' hooks, run under xpcall with error logging). Empty if the project is not running.

getDependencies.desc: Returns, sorted, the extensions required by the nodes (excluding macros) and the modules. Empty if the project is not running.

checkCompileWarnings.desc: Logs an error if a section of the graph has several root nodes (multiple flow colors).

setRunning.desc: Starts or stops the project. On start: plans the root graphs, builds and starts the states, notifies nodes and modules (_executionStarted) and broadcasts 'onExecutionStarted'. On stop: broadcasts 'onRemoveNextFrame' and schedules the stop at the end of the frame, or immediately if stopInstant.

setPaused.desc: Pauses or resumes the project (no effect if stopped).

queueForRestart.desc: Requests a project restart at the end of the frame.

_executionStarted.desc: Notifies graphs and modules of the start (module order by moduleOrder).

_onClear.desc: Called on stop: notifies graphs, variables, modules (onClear) and states.

_executionStopped.desc: Called on stop: notifies graphs, variables and modules (executionStopped), removes the extension proxy, unloads the extensions in extToUnload, resets steps and frameCount to 0.

destroy.desc: Stops the project if it is running, destroys the states and the extension proxy and marks the manager as destroyed.

getGraphByName.desc: Returns the first graph with this name.

resolveVariableChanges.desc: Applies the pending variable changes of the manager and of all graphs.

broadcastCall.desc: If the project is running, calls the given hook function on the extension proxy then on the states (hence on the nodes that listen to it).

broadcastCallReturn.desc: Like broadcastCall, but collects the nodes' results in a table (passed as the first argument to the hooks).

hasNodeForHook.desc: True if the project is running and a node or state listens to this hook.

blocksOnResetGameplay.desc: True if the project is running and one of its nodes declares blocksOnResetGameplay (result cached until the next setRunning).

allNodes.desc: Iterator over all nodes of all graphs: for node in mgr:allNodes() do ... end.

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-mission hook: immediately stops the project if stopRunningOnClientEndMission is true.

getRelativeAbsolutePath.desc: Resolves one or more paths relative to the root, the activity's layer folders, savedDir or the mission folder and returns the first existing file (FS:fileExists). Otherwise returns the first candidate path and false (with a warning unless disabled).

DrawTypeIcon.desc: Draws the icon of a data type (type color, filled if connected) in the editor.
